finding_dispositions.note: PDF pp. 158-161 and 227 of the re-fetched facsimile (SHA-256 648fdb8f matched) were read on page images. The Forma Missae brevior begins on p. 77 (from no. 518). No. 529 stands between the Communion no. 528 and the Super populum no. 530, and only below them come the DOMINICA II IN QUADRAGESIMA heading and its Introit (no. 531). The Second Sunday's Postcommunion is Supplices te rogamus (no. 540, p. 80). Wilson 1915 p. 32 was re-read: the Sunday after the Ember Saturday is marked DIE DOMINICO UACAT and has its own orations, ending with Supplices te rogamus. Scope section 2.5 now says that the typica prints the prayer twice at the Ember Saturday of Lent (nos. 516 and 529) and once with sempiterna at Tuesday of Holy Week (no. 876). It withdraws the Second Sunday claim and restates the Gregorian-places sentence for the two Gregorian days. Sections 2.2, 3.10 and 6.1 and the facsimile binding's loci agree. A normalized literal search of the facsimile's text layer finds the prayer nowhere else.

summary: Research's second reentry for the Claude leaf 57-seventeenth-after-pentecost repaired RES-008. The fetched facsimile's page images (hash matched) show that no. 529 is the Postcommunion of the Forma Missae brevior of the Lenten Ember Saturday, not of the Second Sunday of Lent, whose Postcommunion is Supplices te rogamus (no. 540). Scope sections 2.2, 2.5, 3.10 and 6.1 and the facsimile binding now carry the corrected loci: no. 516 and no. 529 at the Ember Saturday, and no. 876 at Tuesday of Holy Week. Advisories RES-009 to RES-014 were also cleared with new reading: Theodoret on Eph 4:1-6 and Hilary on Ps 118:124 and 137, both read on page images; the 9:17-only Theodotion claim; chronology requests; exact quotations; and the Irenaeus and Preface fixes.
